patches.name: AMOLED Dark Mode For UI
patches.description: Dark-mode backgrounds go pure black.

patches.name: Alert distances
patches.description: Choose how early alerts fire: Standard, Moderate, Heavier or Custom.

options.title: Alert distance level
options.description: Standard keeps Waze's own; Moderate and Heavier warn earlier.

patches.name: Allow high refresh rate
patches.description: Runs Waze above 60 Hz, up to your screen's refresh rate.

options.title: Target refresh rate (Hz)
options.description: Refresh rate ceiling. 120 suits most phones; lower it if the phone gets hot.

patches.name: Auto zoom
patches.description: Keeps your chosen auto-zoom mode from being reset.

options.title: Auto-zoom mode
options.description: speed = zoom out progressively with speed, yes = always on, no = off.

patches.name: Average-speed camera alerts
patches.description: Average-speed camera alerts, with the zone's recommended speed.

patches.name: Brief voice guidance
patches.description: Shorter spoken directions.

patches.name: Car alerts as notifications
patches.description: Delivers police and hazard alerts as car notifications.

patches.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: Stops the Play Store from updating Waze.

patches.name: Enable police & enforcement alerts
patches.description: Turns on police and enforcement alerts.

patches.name: Instrument cluster support
patches.description: Shows the map, alerts and ETA on the car's digital cluster, where it has one.

patches.name: Keep Waze alive on Android Auto
patches.description: Keeps Waze running after you disconnect from Android Auto.

options.title: Minutes alive after disconnect
options.description: Waze shuts down this long after you leave the car.

patches.name: Keep Waze alive on car
patches.description: Keeps Waze connected through car service restarts.

patches.name: Lane guidance
patches.description: Lane guidance, including continue-straight hints.

patches.name: Morphe YouTube Music as a Waze audio partner
patches.description: Lets Morphe YouTube Music work as Waze's audio partner.

patches.name: Radar sound at any speed
patches.description: Plays the speed-camera sound even below the limit.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes ads from Waze.

patches.name: Report speed limit

patches.name: Show FPS counter
patches.description: Shows Waze's frames-per-second counter on the map.

patches.name: Show all cameras & road hazards
patches.description: Shows cameras and road hazards on the map, with alerts.

patches.name: Skip sign-in
patches.description: Boots straight into the map as a guest.

patches.name: Smoother Android Auto map
patches.description: Smoothes the car map's movement and heading on Android Auto.

patches.name: Speed limit sign always shown
patches.description: Always shows the speed limit sign.

patches.name: Speed-limit decrease warnings
patches.description: Warns when the speed limit drops.

patches.name: Speed-limit sign style
patches.description: Picks the sign beside the speedometer: US or World.

options.title: Sign style

patches.name: Speedometer always on
patches.description: Visible at any speed.

patches.description: Keeps Waze running in the background without a route.

patches.name: Theme

options.title: Day theme

options.title: Night theme
options.description: The night map's theme. Stock leaves it untouched.

patches.name: Traffic meter
patches.description: Shows the traffic meter on the car screen.

patches.name: Unlock driver moods
patches.description: Unlocks all moods already on the device.
